signature: SUBROUTINE DLARRF( N, D, L, LD, CLSTRT, CLEND,

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix (subblock, if the matrix split).

params.name: d
params.reference: The N diagonal elements of the diagonal matrix D.

params.name: l
params.reference: The (N-1) subdiagonal elements of the unit bidiagonal matrix L.

params.name: clstrt
params.reference: The index of the first eigenvalue in the cluster.

params.name: clend
params.reference: The index of the last eigenvalue in the cluster.

params.name: w
params.reference: The eigenvalue APPROXIMATIONS of L D L^T in ascending order. W( `CLSTRT` ) through W( `CLEND` ) form the cluster of relatively close eigenalues.

params.name: WGAP
params.reference: The separation from the right neighbor eigenvalue in W.

params.name: WERR
params.reference: `WERR` contain the semiwidth of the uncertainty interval of the corresponding eigenvalue APPROXIMATION in W

params.name: spdiam
params.reference: estimate of the spectral diameter obtained from the Gerschgorin intervals

params.name: clgapr
params.reference: absolute gap on each end of the cluster. Set by the calling routine to protect against shifts too close to eigenvalues outside the cluster.

params.name: pivmin
params.reference: The minimum pivot allowed in the Sturm sequence.

params.name: DPLUS
params.reference: The N diagonal elements of the diagonal matrix `D(+)`.

params.name: LPLUS
params.reference: The first (N-1) elements of `LPLUS` contain the subdiagonal elements of the unit bidiagonal matrix `L(+)`.
